record_title: Exact onset for two-degree-window spread at minimum degree one
limitations: Restricted to minimum degree 1, window width k=1, and integer average degree d>=2, with thresholds interpreted over orders n for which nd is even. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the motivating preprint is extremely recent, so unindexed parallel work remains a residual risk. Independent audit has not been performed.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone finite Erdős-Gallai verification of the explicit extremal degree-sequence families for 2<=d<=100 and 2d+1<=n<=8d.
